practiceReport.name: Treylon Burks
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (WR) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Season-ending Injured Reserve — ineligible to return this season
practiceReport.beatComment: Burks was held out of Friday's practice while managing a foot injury, but he returned Saturday as a full participant, which was enough for him to shed an injury tag for Monday's contest. Over his last six outings, Burks has caught 14 passes on 24 targets for 260 yards and two touchdowns, and he has operated as operated as the Commanders' WR3 since Terry McLaurin suffered a season-ending knee injury in Week 6 against the 49ers.

practiceReport.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: 21-day IR window open (Week 1 ramp); logged Full Participation (FP) on Thursday
Requires formal 53-man roster activation prior to weekly NFL transaction deadline
practiceReport.beatComment: Croskey-Merritt has missed the Commanders' last four games while on injured reserve due to a groin injury. He logged a trio of full practices this week and is officially questionable to play Monday, but it sounds like he'll be activated from IR ahead of the contest and make his return against the Bengals. During Croskey-Merritt's absence, Rachaad White has taken on a larger role in the backfield, but White is currently dealing with a heel injury and is also questionable to suit up Monday.

practiceReport.name: Rachaad White
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Friday Limited (LP) — anchored to player Questionable play prior (76%)
practiceReport.beatComment: White was added to the Commanders' Week 11 injury report Friday as limited due to a heel issue, and he followed it up with a DNP one day later before getting tagged ahead of Monday's matchup. At the same time, current IR member Jacory Croskey-Merritt (groin) completed a full week of drills and also is listed as questionable. If he's activated by Monday afternoon, he'll vie with Austin Ekeler and White for touches, assuming the latter avoids inactive status about 90 minutes before an 8:15 p.m. ET kickoff.

practiceReport.name: Quan Martin
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Thursday Limited Participation (LP); player toughness prior = 78%
practiceReport.beatComment: Martin's practice reps were limited both Thursday and Friday due to a shoulder issue, but his full session Saturday was enough for him to avoid an injury tag for Monday night's game. Martin could see an uptick in defensive snaps if defensive back Amik Robertson (ankle) is not cleared to play against Cincinnati.

practiceReport.name: Amik Robertson
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (7th NFL season, 98% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.

practiceReport.beatComment: Robertson injured his ankle on the final play of Friday's practice, and his reps were limited during Saturday's session. If he's not cleared to play, then Mike Sainristil and Quan Martin would both be in line for more snaps in the Commanders' secondary.

practiceReport.name: Lucas Patrick
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Veteran starter profile (10th NFL season, 77% snap share) — elevated Questionable active conversion (84%) & Wednesday maintenance tolerance.
factors: Logged mid-week Full Participation in NFL Concussion Protocol progression
practiceReport.beatComment: Patrick was a full participant in all three practices during Week 11 prep. Head coach Dan Quinn confirmed with reporters Saturday that Patrick cleared the league's concussion protocol and would start at center Monday, but the injury designation means that is not a guarantee. Nick Allegretti would likely start at center in the event that Patrick doesn't play.

practiceReport.name: Jayden Daniels
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Every-down starter workload (94% snaps) — 82% active conversion baseline when logging Limited Friday reps.
practiceReport.beatComment: It was a up-and-down night for Daniels in the narrow division win, as the third-year quarterback's pair of fourth-quarter interceptions threatened to derail Washington's fortunes. Daniels had the Commanders up by a 17-14 score just past the midway point of the third quarter after tossing one- and 31-yard touchdown passes to Ben Sinnott and Antonio Williams, respectively. However, Daniels subsequently squandered one scoring opportunity by throwing interceptions on back-to-back possessions in the fourth quarter, the first at the Giants' two-yard line. He ultimately made up for it with his game-winning 32-yard scoring strike to Stefon Diggs, marking the quarterback's first three-TD-pass tally of the season. Daniels is up to 1,499 passing yards and a 10:2 TD:INT alongside 280 rushing yards and another pair of scores heading into a Week 11 home matchup against the Bengals on Monday night, Nov. 23.

practiceReport.name: Chig Okonkwo
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
practiceReport.beatComment: Okonkwo exited in the second quarter due to a back injury, but he was back out there on the field after halftime and was the target on both of Jayden Daniels' two interceptions with less than six minutes remaining in the contest. Overall, Okonkwo's eight targets marked a season high, but he also mustered his fewest receiving yards since Week 4. He'll look to build upon his season-long line of 27-263-0 on 39 targets in the Commanders' next game Monday, Nov. 23 versus the Bengals.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Laremy Tunsil
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: Tunsil underwent surgery in August to repair a torn triceps. The left tackle continues to recover, but he likely will not suit up for the Commanders in 2026 unless the team makes a playoff run. Even then, it remains unclear whether Tunsil would be able to return at all before the 2027 season.
